items.q: What time will the main bus depart from the station?
items.exp: Yo'ldagi ta'mirlash ishlari sababli avtobus rejalashtirilgan soat 9:00 da emas, balki 9:15 da yo'lga chiqadi.

items.q: When was the historic castle constructed?
items.exp: Matnda birinchi bekat bo'lgan tarixiy qasr 14-asrda (fourteenth century) qurilgani aytilgan.

items.q: What item is NOT included in the tour ticket?
items.exp: Tushlik chipta narxiga kiritilgan, lekin ichimliklarni restoranda alohida sotib olish lozim.

items.q: Where is the final meeting point for the group at 4:30 PM?
items.exp: Guruh a'zolari ajralib qolgan taqdirda, oxirgi uchrashuv joyi soat 16:30 da markaziy soat minorasi oldi qilib belgilangan.

listening.script: Welcome to the city highlights tour. Before we begin our journey today, I would like to share a few important details about our schedule. First, our main bus will leave the station at nine fifteen sharp, instead of the original time of nine o'clock, due to brief road maintenance. Our first stop will be the historic castle built in the fourteenth century, where we will spend about one hour exploring the outer gardens. After that, we will head down to the old harbour for a fresh seafood lunch. Please note that lunch is included in your tour ticket, but drinks must be purchased separately at the restaurant. In the afternoon, you will have two hours of free time to shop in the local craft market. If anyone gets separated from the group, our final meeting point will be outside the central clock tower at four thirty in the afternoon. Have a wonderful trip!

reading.title: Uyqu nima uchun muhim
reading.meta: True / False / Not Given · 4 ta savol
reading.text: Scientists have long known that sleep is essential, but recent studies show how deeply it affects daily life. Adults who sleep fewer than six hours a night are more likely to feel stressed and to make mistakes at work. A survey of 2,000 office workers found that those who slept seven to eight hours were twice as productive as colleagues who slept less. Some people believe that sleeping late at weekends can repair the damage of a short week, but researchers say this only helps partially. Experts recommend keeping regular bedtimes and avoiding screens for an hour before sleep.

items.q: Adults who sleep under six hours tend to feel more stressed.
items.exp: Matn: more likely to feel stressed. True.

items.q: The survey included 2,000 office workers.
items.exp: Matn: A survey of 2,000 office workers. True.

items.q: Sleeping late at weekends fully repairs a short week.
items.exp: Matn: this only helps partially. False.

items.q: Doctors recommend drinking warm milk before bed.
items.exp: Sut haqida matnda gap yo'q. Not Given.

reading.title: Alp qishlog'ida barqaror turizm
reading.meta: True / False / Not Given · 4 ta savol

items.q: Local business owners experienced a permanent decrease in total revenue after vehicle restrictions were introduced.
items.exp: Noto'g'ri. Matnda 'While some business owners initially feared a drop in income, overall revenue has actually risen by fifteen percent' deb ko'rsatilgan, ya'ni daromad kamaymagan, aksincha 15 foizga oshgan.

items.q: Money collected from vehicle parking fees is used to maintain local trails and historic buildings.
items.exp: To'g'ri. Matndagi 'The revenue generated from municipal parking fees is reinvested directly into maintaining local hiking trails and preserving traditional timber architecture' jumlasiga ko'ra, to'xtash joyi tushumlari so'qmoqlar va me'morchilikni saqlashga sarflanadi.

items.q: Neighboring villages plan to launch their own digital loyalty pass systems next year.
items.exp: Berilmagan. Matnda qo'shni qishloqlar raqamli tizim xarajatlarini tanqid qilgani ('neighboring villages have criticized the high operational costs') aytilgan, ammo ularning kelasi yili shunday tizim joriy etish rejalari haqida ma'lumot yo'q.

items.q: What was the primary reason local authorities introduced new vehicle regulations in 2021?
opts: To force visitors to buy digital loyalty passes
To reduce the negative environmental impact of tourist traffic
To fund the construction of modern cable cars
To generate extra income for local business owners
items.exp: To'g'ri javob B. Matnda ta'kidlanishicha: 'Local authorities implemented strict vehicle regulations in 2021 to combat the environmental impact of increased tourist traffic'.

reading.text:
Over the past decade, eco-tourism has transformed the small alpine village of Lauterbrunnen from a quiet seasonal destination into a year-round travel hotspot. Located in a steep Swiss valley known for its 72 waterfalls, the village traditionally relied on summer hiking and winter skiing. However, recent local initiatives have encouraged tourists to engage in sustainable activities, such as guided electric-bike tours and farm-to-table dining experiences.

Local authorities implemented strict vehicle regulations in 2021 to combat the environmental impact of increased tourist traffic. Visitors are now required to park their cars outside the main village area and rely on public electric buses or walking. While some business owners initially feared a drop in income, overall revenue has actually risen by fifteen percent. The revenue generated from municipal parking fees is reinvested directly into maintaining local hiking trails and preserving traditional timber architecture.

Furthermore, the local tourism board introduced a digital loyalty pass for visitors staying longer than three nights. This pass grants free access to municipal museums and discounts on regional cable cars. Although the initiative has successfully increased the average length of stay, neighboring villages have criticized the high operational costs of maintaining such digital programs. Nevertheless, Lauterbrunnen remains a pioneering model for sustainable tourism in mountainous regions.
reading.en: Sustainable Tourism in an Alpine Village

items.exp: Yagona narsa oldidan the.

items.exp: Ovqat nomlari oldida artikl qo'yilmaydi.

items.q: He plays ___ guitar very well.
items.exp: Musiqa asboblari oldida the.

items.q: The meeting is ___ Monday.
items.exp: Hafta kunlari oldidan on.

items.q: She was born ___ 1998.
items.exp: Yillar oldidan in.

items.q: I am interested ___ science.
items.exp: interested in.

items.q: He has lived here ___ 2015.
items.exp: Aniq boshlanish nuqtasi bilan since.

items.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
items.exp: First conditional: if + Present, will + fe'l.

items.q: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
items.exp: Second conditional: if + Past (were).

items.q: If she had studied, she ___ the exam.
items.exp: Third conditional: would have + V3.

items.q: Unless you hurry, you ___ the bus.
items.exp: Unless + Present, will + fe'l.

items.q: The streets are completely wet this morning. It ___ heavily during the night.
items.exp: Ertalab ko'chalar ho'l bo'lgani uchun tunda yomg'ir yog'gani aniq (o'tgan zamondagi ishonch) va buning uchun 'must have + V3' ishlatiladi.

items.q: I failed my IELTS listening module. I ___ more attention to the audio distractors.
items.exp: O'tgan zamonda bajarilmagan, lekin bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan ish-harakat yoki afsuslanishni bildirish uchun 'should have + V3' strukturasi qo'llaniladi.

items.q: Sarah hasn't arrived yet. She ___ the wrong train, but I am not entirely sure.
items.exp: O'tgan zamondagi noaniq ehtimollikni bildirish uchun 'might have + V3' birikmasi ishlatiladi.

items.q: You ___ submit your essay today; the professor extended the deadline until Friday.
items.exp: Topshirish muddati uzaytirilgani sababli bugun insho topshirish majburiy emas. Majburiyat yo'qligini ko'rsatish uchun 'don't have to' ishlatiladi.

items.q: Despite the heavy traffic, we ___ reach the test center just in time.
items.exp: O'tmishda qiyin bir vaziyatda biror aniq ishni uddalash yoki bajarishga erishish uchun 'was/were able to' qo'llaniladi.

writing: Some people believe that governments should spend money on public transport rather than building new roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Many people now work from home. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.
In many countries, young people spend too much time on social media. What problems does this cause and what can be done?
Some people think university education should be free for everyone. Others think students should pay. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Nowadays more people choose to live alone. Is this a positive or negative development?

Some people believe that traveling to foreign countries is essential for broadening a person's horizons, while others argue that modern technology allows people to experience different cultures without leaving home. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Popular tourist destinations around the world are increasingly suffering from overcrowding and environmental degradation. What problems does this cause, and what solutions can be implemented to address this issue?

Some people believe that international travel is the best way to gain an understanding of other cultures, while others think that reading books and watching documentaries can provide the same level of insight. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

In many countries, popular tourist destinations are suffering from the negative impacts of overtourism. What are the main problems associated with this issue, and what measures can governments and individuals take to solve them?
Some people think that traveling to other countries is no longer necessary because we can learn about different cultures through the internet and television. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

In many parts of the world, popular tourist destinations are facing severe environmental degradation due to overtourism. What are the main causes of this problem, and what solutions can governments implement to address it?
speaking:
Describe a teacher who influenced you.
You should say: who this person was, what they taught you, how they behaved in class, and explain why they influenced you.

Describe a place in your city that you like to visit.
You should say: where it is, how often you go there, what you do there, and explain why you like it.

Describe a time when you helped someone.
You should say: who you helped, how you helped them, why they needed help, and how you felt afterwards.

Describe a useful app on your phone.
You should say: what it is, how often you use it, what it does, and explain why it is useful.

Describe a family celebration you remember well.
You should say: what the occasion was, who was there, what you did, and explain why you remember it.
